evidence_class: sequence motif determined by the query's own residues
how_it_is_located: direct regex on the full-length sequence
measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: MEASURED: 2,090 of 2,202 labelled collection proteins carry it, 94.9 percent. Contrast 56 of 66, 84.8 percent, on the historical GII substrate
multiplicity: 251 of 2,202 proteins carry MORE THAN ONE - 11.4 percent. A multiplicity rule is mandatory and must be declared before use
families_where_it_fails: 7 families below 90 percent: UG13 52.0, UG23 66.7, UG15 69.2, UG21 69.6, G2L 76.4, UG12 86.5, Retrons 89.6
independent_of_the_instrument: YES - the only anchor whose position needs no model
may_be_used_as: held-out landmark check, PROVIDED it is masked from derivation, features and thresholds

definition: where the dyad falls relative to the Pfam RVT_1 window
how_it_is_located: compare motif position to the mapped RVT_1 span
measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: MEASURED: when a mapped protein carries a dyad, the dyad lies inside the RVT_1 window in 1,751 of 1,758 cases - 99.6 percent
may_be_used_as: evidence that the dyad is a reliable WITHIN-CORE anchor, not that the core is correctly bounded

measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: the window is present on every seed by construction; occupancy on non-seed proteins is UNMEASURED and must be piloted
multiplicity: one hit per protein in the myRT build; multi-hit behaviour on full-length proteins is UNMEASURED
independent_of_the_instrument: YES of this project, NO of myRT - myRT's seeds were cut to this window
may_be_used_as: the primary scaffold candidate; an external coordinate system predating and independent of every project artefact

definition: match states of the 45 myRT family HMMs
measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: NSEQ sums to 1,988 with every family's NSEQ equal to its FASTA count
families_where_it_fails: families whose seeds lack full-length parents - AbiP2, UG24, AbiK and 5 others
independent_of_the_instrument: NO - Stage-1 family labels are this system's own collapsed output
may_be_used_as: family-classification CONTEXT and a comparator for core localisation. NEVER as family ground truth

definition: the historical landmarks recovered in g2, in LtrA coordinates
how_it_is_located: project the g2 frame onto a query via the shared coordinate carrier
measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: 27 of 28 prior landmark placements fall inside a reconstructed g2 region; 6 of 7 sit at the identical LtrA residue across four prior frames
families_where_it_fails: RT1 is the only landmark that moves between frames; RT0 has no reconstructed region at all
independent_of_the_instrument: NO for GII-like sequences - LtrA is the carrier
may_be_used_as: CROSSWALK ONLY, after the broad frame is frozen. May not seed the broad frame

definition: the four conserved RNA-dependent polymerase motifs of Poch et al. 1989
independent_of_the_instrument: YES - published, predates every project artefact, and is the most general RT motif set available
may_be_used_as: STRONG CANDIDATE for a second and third anchor, and the obvious way to reduce sole dependence on A_DYAD. Must be measured before the panel is frozen

definition: fingers/palm/thumb elements from the 39 local RT structures
how_it_is_located: DSSP boundaries already extracted for 25 structures
measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: 21 of 38 families have no structure at all; prior sequence-to-structure cross-validation covers only 11 of 25 with thumb Jaccard 0.0 for five
independent_of_the_instrument: only if never used to define a sequence anchor

measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: A_DYAD at 94.9 percent broad occupancy is the strongest single anchor available and still fails in 7 families, one of them at 52 percent
may_be_used_as: the design must be MULTI-ANCHOR, and per-family anchor availability must be declared BEFORE derivation, not discovered after

definition: anchor-poor families are named in advance
measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: UG13, UG23, UG15, UG21, G2L, UG12 and Retrons are below 90 percent dyad occupancy
may_be_used_as: these families are predeclared as anchor-poor; a low mapping rate there is an expected property of the reference material, not a finding about biology

definition: the primary target is not exempt
measured_occupancy_in_the_broad_panel: Retrons sit at 89.6 percent, just below the 90 percent line
may_be_used_as: retron results must carry this figure alongside them; the instrument's weakest common anchor is measurably weaker in the focal class
